title: Make message-not-found errors distinguish root causes
description:
Location: crates/kith-store/src/message.rs, lines 274 and 290

Error messages "message not found: {id}" don't distinguish between:
1. Caller passed a bad ID (caller bug)
2. Message exists but belongs to a different chat (caller isolation bug)
3. Race condition: message was deleted between check and update (transient)

In update_delivery_state() (line 274) and update_read_at() (line 290), the caller (likely in kith-jmap or kith-chat) may need to know which happened.

Suggestion: Check if the message exists in a different chat before returning the error, or return a more specific error type.
